FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Bonsoir, Madame !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye, Sir.
   B. What is your name?
   C. How do you spell it?
   D. Good evening, Madam!

2. What does 'Bonjour, Amina !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello, Amina!
   B. Pleased to meet you!
   C. I am well, thank you.
   D. Yes, I am fine.

3. Which letters say wa in bonsoir? (1 mark)
   A. oi
   B. ou
   C. au
   D. on

4. What does 'Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is called Kamau.
   B. Here is my grandmother.
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. This is my brother.

5. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: How many brothers and sisters does Amina have in total? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 1
   C. 3
   D. 2

6. What does 'Voici ma famille.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my family.
   B. Who is it?
   C. It is the baby.
   D. My sister is called Njeri.

7. Which little word goes with 'salon' (the living room)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. le
   D. la

8. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: What is near the door? (1 mark)
   A. the sofa
   B. the fridge
   C. the bed
   D. the cat

9. What does 'Le samedi, je joue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Thursday, I sing.
   B. What day is it today?
   C. On Saturday, I play.
   D. On Saturday, I help my mother.

10. What does 'Une semaine, sept jours.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I play.
   B. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   C. What day is it today?
   D. A week, seven days.

11. Fill in: Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 ______. (1 mark)
   A. jour
   B. mai
   C. lundi
   D. dix

12. Which little word goes with 'chanson'? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

13. Read: Le matin, je mange du pain et je bois du thé. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. Le soir, je mange du poisson. Question: What does the speaker drink in the morning? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. tea
   C. milk
   D. juice

14. What does 'Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning, I eat bread.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. It is not good for your health.
   D. It is good for your health.

15. Which little word goes with 'ventre' (the stomach)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. les

16. Which little word goes with 'cou' (the neck)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

17. What does 'Quel temps fait-il ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. It is hot.
   C. It is snowing.
   D. What is the weather like?

18. Which is harsh weather? (1 mark)
   A. il fait chaud
   B. le beau temps
   C. l'orage
   D. le soleil

19. What does 'De rien !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Turn left.
   B. You are welcome!
   C. Excuse me, where is the school?
   D. The rug is under the table.

20. Which little word goes with 'tapis' (the rug)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. les
   D. l'

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est devant le canapé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into English: 'Le livre est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into English: 'À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. Translate into English: 'Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Translate into English: 'Le lit est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Read the poem line: Lundi, mardi, mercredi. Write the three days that follow in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into English: 'Et toi ?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: 'C'est le bébé.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: 'Le jeudi, je chante.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Good evening, Madam!
   Bonsoir, Madame ! means Good evening, Madam!

2. A — Hello, Amina!
   Bonjour, Amina ! means Hello, Amina!

3. A — oi
   In French, oi says wa.

4. A — My brother is called Kamau.
   Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. means My brother is called Kamau.

5. D — 2
   She has one brother and one sister.

6. A — Here is my family.
   Voici ma famille. means Here is my family.

7. C — le
   salon is masculine, so we say le salon.

8. B — the fridge
   Le frigo est près de la porte.

9. C — On Saturday, I play.
   Le samedi, je joue. means On Saturday, I play.

10. D — A week, seven days.
   Une semaine, sept jours. means A week, seven days.

11. B — mai
   A date needs a month, such as mai.

12. B — la
   chanson is feminine, so we say la chanson.

13. B — tea
   Je bois du thé.

14. C — It is not good for your health.
   Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé. means It is not good for your health.

15. C — le
   ventre is masculine, so we say le ventre.

16. B — le
   cou is masculine, so we say le cou.

17. D — What is the weather like?
   Quel temps fait-il ? means What is the weather like?

18. C — l'orage
   A storm can be dangerous.

19. B — You are welcome!
   De rien ! means You are welcome!

20. A — le
   tapis is masculine, so we say le tapis.

SECTION B
----

   Answer: It is not good for your health.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 4 marks in total.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: The bed is in the bedroom.

27. (3 marks)

   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
